subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the security owners accept the remaining credential-bearing action revisions as one grouped update after current-main regeneration and exact-source verification?
rationale: The assertion repairs are mechanical, but accepting multiple third-party executable revisions in privileged workflows as one supply-chain review unit requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Regenerate and approve group
options.body: Recreate the group from current main, repair all guards, and approve the narrowed exact-head batch after source and workflow validation.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, registry, Codex, release, and CodeQL revisions into smaller supply-chain review units.

options.title: Pause update
options.body: Retain the current pins until each privileged revision can receive adequate owner review.

recommendation.title: Regenerate and approve group
recommendation.body: Recreate the group from current main, repair all guards, and approve the narrowed exact-head batch after source and workflow validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This team owns the central security workflows and dependency-guard contracts affected by the trust decision.
